title: IBAN validator
description: Takes an IBAN string (spaces and lowercase allowed) and returns whether it is valid per the country's BBAN structure and the ISO 13616 mod-97 checksum, with an error code and message when not, the electronic and print-formatted forms, country code, check digits (actual and expected), BBAN and its parsed fields such as bank_code, branch_code and account_number. Supports the 100+ countries covered by iban4j.
